rollups.text: Photography equipment and learning: Canon EOS 80D owned and used; dust spots noticed and built-in sensor cleaning planned (2023-05-21); Canon EF 50mm f/1.8 STM bought at Best Buy for $150 (2023-05-21); storage cube bought from Amazon for camera accessories and reported to be working well (2023-05-21); Peak Design Everyday Backpack considered for the camera gear (2023-05-21); Lightroom beginner guidance sought while editing RAW files from a photo walk (2023-05-21); remote shutter or timer considered to reduce camera shake (2023-05-21).

Fishing activities and gear: fished Lake Michigan with buddy Alex (2023-05-20..2023-05-21), catching 12 trout with spinners and PowerBait, including a 3-pound trout; wants to restock hooks and sinkers and organize the tackle box (2023-05-23); considering trying pike fishing and exploring new Lake Michigan areas (2023-05-23). On a guided Canada fishing trip with the user's father (April 2023), caught several large pike; guide Mike taught a hook-setting technique that the user later practiced and credited with improving the catch rate (April–May 2023).

Tennis learning and improvement: by 2023-05-23, the user had taken lessons for about a month and played indoor basketball with coworkers twice weekly for about six weeks. They enjoyed tennis socially and mentally, were working on their backhand with a patient instructor, and wanted a more consistent serve toss and follow-through; drills progressed from toss practice to rehearsing the swing and then hitting a ball, with the user saying the drills helped but the serve remained inconsistent (2023-05-23). By 2023-05-30, the user played recreational tennis at a local community center, had noticed a difference after trying a new racket, and sought serve advice and strength and plyometric exercises to improve court agility. The assistant recommended plyometrics 2–3 times weekly with rest between sessions (2023-05-30). Elapsed time between the dated tennis discussions: 7 days.

Car-shopping research: on 2023-05-23, the user was planning to buy a fuel-efficient car for a new job commute of about 45 minutes each way, driving roughly 200–250 miles weekly, mostly highway. The user preferred a sedan or hatchback, had a budget around $25,000, and prioritized highway fuel economy, daily comfort, responsive driving, and user-friendly infotainment. The user explored the Toyota Corolla Hybrid's safety, infotainment, interior comfort, and driving dynamics; no purchase was reported. All recorded research occurred on the same date.

Meal-kit and food-delivery choices: the user had recently tried HelloFresh and received 40% off the first order (2023-05-23); was considering Sun Basket and Home Chef, prioritizing dietary accommodations and lower-carbohydrate, lower-sugar meals over recipe variety; planned to investigate Sun Basket's low-carb plan (2023-05-23). The user had also been using Uber Eats frequently while trying to eat out less (2023-05-23), received a 20% Uber Eats discount during the week of 2023-05-21..2023-05-27, and on 2023-05-28 planned another Uber Eats order, possibly veggie lasagna from a new downtown Italian restaurant after checking reviews and promotions. Elapsed time from the meal-kit comparison to the later restaurant-order plan: 5 days.

Spiritual exploration: in April 2023, the user attended an Islamic prayer service downtown and an iftar dinner at Amir's home, as part of interest in exploring spiritual practices outside their comfort zone. About a month before 2023-05-25, a heated discussion with friend Alex about God's existence prompted reflection on personal beliefs. On 2023-05-25, the user sought resources on atheism and agnosticism and explored religious views of hell and the afterlife, expressing uncertainty about the literal-eternal-suffering teaching they grew up with and interest in symbolic or spiritual interpretations. On 2023-05-27, the user was trying to resume regular spiritual practice and considering local services; they were especially interested in returning to St. Mary's Church after a moving Mass the previous month. Elapsed time from the reported April experiences to the latest dated reflection: approximately one to two months.

Gardening plans: on 2023-05-25, the user planned to prepare soil, was awaiting a trowel and pruners, and had newly planted tomatoes, peppers, and cucumbers. The user chose a bamboo teepee trellis for cucumbers and planned to divide the garden into zones and add mulching and composting to a to-do list; old gloves needed replacement. The user had also been considering living-room plants, including a fiddle leaf fig, on 2023-05-21 and additional easy-care plants on 2023-05-23. Elapsed time between the first and latest dated plant discussions: 4 days.

Fresh Earth Ecosystem reference project: on 2023-05-23, the user clarified that Fresh Earth Community and Fresh Earth Expert Network are one community empowered by the Fresh Earth Ecosystem (FEE), not separate entities. The user wanted a logically ordered, detailed component reference with names and cross-references finalized before restarting the presentation deck, followed by an explanation of how components connect and support a global movement. Required entries included stakeholders, B2B Marketplace Sandbox, projects, validation systems, widgets, programs, farm plans, health plans, problem, cost, solution, opportunity, auditing, digital twin, and FE Impact Sandbox; health plans combine designer-developed programs added to a library of validated systems. The ecosystem supply chain should be called the Fresh Earth Supply Chain (FESC). All recorded steps were on the same date; no completion was recorded.

Pulmonary embolism and anticoagulation follow-up: the user was diagnosed with a small pulmonary embolism in March 2023 and hospitalized for anticoagulation therapy from 2023-03-18 to 2023-03-21. On 2023-05-28, the user said they had been taking blood thinners, wanted general information about preventing recurrence and taking medication correctly, and said they would confirm their regimen with a healthcare provider. They had also been advised to wear compression stockings and planned to discuss their situation with a provider. The user preferred general, nontechnical questions rather than assuming familiarity with drug names or acronyms. Elapsed time from hospital discharge to the follow-up discussion: about 68 days.

Public-speaking development: on 2023-05-28, the user sought advice on improving public speaking, managing nervousness, handling interruptions, and finding resources. They especially liked humor as a way to handle unexpected interruptions and planned to practice, use relaxation techniques, and apply the tips at their next presentation. The recorded discussion and plan occurred on the same date.

Six-week campaign planning: on 2023-05-27, the user said they were working on a major campaign, generally about 40 hours weekly with occasional late work, and felt overwhelmed. They wanted better time management and prioritization, understood SMART goals, and asked for help applying them, planning a six-week content calendar, and choosing social-media posting frequency. They also asked how to measure campaign success using ROI and CAC. The record gives no later outcome.

Nepal trekking preparation: the user was seriously considering a 10-day trek in Nepal in summer 2024 and, on 2023-05-28, considered an Eagle Creek Travel Wallet for documents and receipts. The user planned to bring several chip-and-PIN credit cards and a portable Wi-Fi hotspot with security precautions, and was concerned about altitude sickness and the environmental footprint. No booking or completed trip was reported.

Palm Springs trip planning: the user and friends planned to visit Palm Springs from 2024-03-01 through 2024-03-08. On 2023-05-30, the user asked about expected weather, activities, vegan-friendly restaurants, and a possible Joshua Tree National Park visit. The Joshua Tree information was exploratory, not confirmation of a visit. Elapsed time from the planning discussion to the trip start: about 276 days.

Clothing and accessories purchased or considered: Gucci silk scarf bought for $200 at an upscale downtown mall (2023-05-30); Target tops at $10 each, which the user liked as casual styling options with the scarf (2023-05-30); floor-length ASOS gown bought for $80 and considered for a black-tie event with the scarf (2023-05-30); user also said they owned a Coach designer handbag, Jimmy Choo heels, and an Omega watch bought for $2,000 in April 2023, and considered coordinating them with the scarf (2023-05-30).

Recurring wellness routines and milestones: the user reported doing 20 minutes of yoga every morning before work (2023-05-23); later reported practicing yoga every other evening and finding it relaxing and helpful for sleep (2023-05-30). On weekends, the user liked oatmeal with banana and honey for breakfast (2023-05-30). The user was planning outfits on Sundays and taking stock of wardrobe needs (2023-05-30), and was maintaining an evening skincare routine and a journal listing three gratitudes and three next-day goals (2023-05-30).

The user reported two separate 20% discounts on Uber Eats: one received during 2023-05-21..2023-05-27, and another discount was not specified for the later planned order; the record says the user received 20% off an order during the earlier week, then planned to use Uber Eats again. Do not infer that the later order also had a discount.

The user had at least two recorded running personal-best references, both for 3 miles in 25 minutes 12 seconds: reported on 2023-05-30 as achieved two weeks earlier, and separately dated approximately 2023-05-16. These appear to describe the same performance, not two distinct runs.
